text.contrast: Da do WCAG: moi cap chu/nen >= 4,63 (chuan AA 4,5). Nen navy sang hon nen tim cu nen chu phai sang len tuong ung — dung ha do sang cua chu.

semantic.comment: Kit khong dinh nghia mau trang thai — anh xa vao bang mau kit thay vi bia mau moi.

vietnamese.comment: Owner chot 17/08/2026: chu tieng Viet GIU font hien tai. Trong DApp/Admin font hien tai la Sora (tieu de) va Space Grotesk (than bai) — KHONG phai Montserrat (do la landing).

rules: Con dau dung dung nhu da ve — khong ve lai, doi mau, lam phang, xoay, keo gian.
Khong dat gi vao trong vong, len dia cau, hay len dai bang.
Nen toi thi cat tron con dau (scale 1.06), khong dan o vuong.
Dau day du toi thieu 200px; app icon 120px; duoi 120px dung monogram MIC.
Khoang trong quanh dau = 1/4 duong kinh.
Slogan doc tron cau, khong ngat giua chung.
Chu Hy Lap giu nguyen, khong dich, khong chu nguon.
Seal Gold khong bao gio lam nen.
Can trai moi noi; lockup doc la cho duy nhat can giua.

assetLimits.comment: Con dau CHI co ban raster (seal-source.png 1254px). O 300dpi tuong duong ~10,6cm — du cho danh thiep, KHONG du cho A4 tran vien hay standee. lockup-horizontal.svg ben trong cung la anh nhung. Cac file vector that: monogram, wordmark, chip $MIC, duong Hy Lap.

migration.comment: Anh xa tu bo mau DApp/Admin cu (indigo-plum) sang bo moi.
